tasks.title: PRIMUS'26 Brand Identity & Keynote Stage Package
tasks.description: Design the complete visual identity, keynote stage LED backdrop templates, and speaker reveal deck for PRIMUS'26.
tasks.instructions: Follow TVC's dark editorial aesthetic (#0d0d0d canvas, #f5ed00 accent). Break down asset production into subtasks for Level 1 associates as needed.
tasks.expected_deliverables:
1. Master Figma system link
2. 4K LED stage backdrop exports
3. Social announcement templates

tasks.title: Speaker Spotlight Social Cards (Subtask)
tasks.description: Create 12 responsive Instagram & LinkedIn speaker cards matching the PRIMUS'26 master grid.
tasks.instructions: Use the master typography tokens from parent task #task-parent-001 and export 1080x1350 PNGs.
tasks.expected_deliverables: Figma frame link + exported PNG folder link

tasks.title: E-Summit'26 Founder hospitality & Airport Reception Desk
tasks.description: Coordinate guest speaker arrival schedules, welcome kits, and VIP green-room readiness during E-Summit.
tasks.instructions: Open task pool for Level 1 & Level 2 members across Logistics and Outreach. Claim a slot to join the reception squad.
tasks.expected_deliverables: Completed flight tracker sheet + on-ground checklist sign-off

tasks.title: B-Hackathon Live Leaderboard & Judge Scoring Portal QA
tasks.description: Verify real-time scoring calculations, mobile responsiveness, and rate-limiting on the judge evaluation endpoints.
tasks.instructions: Run load tests and submit the QA verification report.
tasks.expected_deliverables: Playwright / Lighthouse report + bug resolution PR

task_assignments.submission_notes: Completed all 12 speaker cards following the monochrome + #f5ed00 accent grid. Ready for Core review.

task_comments.content: Make sure the rocket emblem watermark stays at 8% opacity on dark backgrounds.

messages.content: Welcome to TVC Exclusive — our unified internal operating system. All flagship sprint tasks for PRIMUS'26 and E-Summit'26, department channels, and onboarding workflows are now live here.
All Level 2 Core & General Members: Level 1 associate applications for the new semester are open in the Applications tab. Please review candidates aligned with your department interests.
